      "content": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, DateTime, ForeignKey, REAL, CheckConstraint, UniqueConstraint\nfrom sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base\n\nBase = declarative_base()\n\nclass User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    username = Column(String, nullable=False, unique=True)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Aircraft(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"aircraft\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    tail_number = Column(String, nullable=False, unique=True)\n    model = Column(String)\n    manufacturer = Column(String)\n    passenger_capacity = Column(Integer, CheckConstraint(\"passenger_capacity IS NULL OR passenger_capacity >= 0\"))\n    baggage_capacity_lbs = Column(REAL, CheckConstraint(\"baggage_capacity_lbs IS NULL OR baggage_capacity_lbs >= 0\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Airport(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"airports\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    icao_code = Column(String, nullable=False, unique=True)\n    iata_code = Column(String, unique=True)\n    name = Column(String)\n    city = Column(String)\n    country = Column(String)\n    latitude = Column(REAL)\n    longitude = Column(REAL)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\nclass Flight(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"flights\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    flight_number = Column(String)\n    aircraft_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"aircraft.id\"), nullable=False)\n    origin_airport_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"airports.id\"), nullable=False)\n    destination_airport_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"airports.id\"), nullable=False)\n    departure_datetime_utc = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)\n    arrival_datetime_utc = Column(DateTime)\n    flight_type = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"charter\", CheckConstraint(\"flight_type IN ('charter', 'scheduled', 'private', 'cargo', 'ferry')\"))\n    status = Column(String, nullable=False, default=\"scheduled\", CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('scheduled', 'boarding', 'departed', 'en_route', 'landed', 'cancelled', 'delayed')\"))\n    passenger_count = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0, CheckConstraint(\"passenger_count >= 0\"))\n    baggage_weight_lbs = Column(REAL, nullable=False, default=0, CheckConstraint(\"baggage_weight_lbs >= 0\"))\n    special_requests = Column(String)\n    created_by_user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"users.id\"), nullable=False)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)\n\n    __table_args__ = (\n        CheckConstraint(\"origin_airport_id <> destination_airport_id\"),\n    )"

      "path": "schemas.py",
      "content": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom typing import Optional\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\n\nclass FlightIn(BaseModel):\n    flight_number: Optional[str] = None\n    tail_number: str = Field(..., description=\"Tail number of the aircraft assigned to this flight\")\n    origin_icao_code: str = Field(..., description=\"ICAO code of the departure airport\")\n    destination_icao_code: str = Field(..., description=\"ICAO code of the arrival airport\")\n    departure_datetime_utc: datetime = Field(..., description=\"Scheduled departure datetime in UTC\")\n    passenger_count: int = Field(..., ge=0)\n    baggage_weight_lbs: float = Field(..., ge=0)\n    special_requests: Optional[str] = None\n\n\nclass FlightOut(BaseModel):\n    id: int\n    flight_number: Optional[str] = None\n    aircraft_id: int\n    origin_airport_id: int\n    destination_airport_id: int\n    departure_datetime_utc: datetime\n    arrival_datetime_utc: Optional[datetime] = None\n    flight_type: str\n    status: str\n    passenger_count: int\n    baggage_weight_lbs: float\n    special_requests: Optional[str] = None\n    created_by_user_id: int\n    created_at: datetime\n    updated_at: datetime\n\n    model_config = dict(from_attributes=True)"
    },
    {
      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Flight, Aircraft, Airport, User\nfrom schemas import FlightIn, FlightOut\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"Flights\"])\n\n\n@router.post(\"/api/flights\", operation_id=\"create_flight\", response_model=FlightOut)\nasync def create_flight(payload: FlightIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):\n    # Find the user (assuming current user is user ID 1 for now)\n    user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == 1).first()\n    if not user:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"User not found\")\n\n    # Find aircraft by tail number\n    aircraft = db.query(Aircraft).filter(Aircraft.tail_number == payload.tail_number).first()\n    if not aircraft:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Aircraft not found\")\n\n    # Find origin and destination airports\n    origin_airport = db.query(Airport).filter(Airport.icao_code == payload.origin_icao_code).first()\n    if not origin_airport:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Origin airport not found\")\n\n    destination_airport = db.query(Airport).filter(Airport.icao_code == payload.destination_icao_code).first()\n    if not destination_airport:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Destination airport not found\")\n\n    # Validate aircraft capacity\n    if aircraft.passenger_capacity is not None and payload.passenger_count > aircraft.passenger_capacity:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,\n                            detail=\"Passenger count exceeds aircraft capacity\")\n\n    if aircraft.baggage_capacity_lbs is not None and payload.baggage_weight_lbs > aircraft.baggage_capacity_lbs:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,\n                            detail=\"Baggage weight exceeds aircraft capacity\")\n\n    # Create the flight\n    flight = Flight(\n        flight_number=payload.flight_number,\n        aircraft_id=aircraft.id,\n        origin_airport_id=origin_airport.id,\n        destination_airport_id=destination_airport.id,\n        departure_datetime_utc=payload.departure_datetime_utc,\n        passenger_count=payload.passenger_count,\n        baggage_weight_lbs=payload.baggage_weight_lbs,\n        special_requests=payload.special_requests,\n        created_by_user_id=user.id,\n    )\n\n    db.add(flight)\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(flight)\n\n    return flight"
    }
  ]
